title: CIA Triad + Non-repudiation
rows: Only authorized parties can access or read the data
Data is not altered without detection
Systems and data are accessible when legitimately needed
An action cannot be credibly denied by the party who performed it

title: Indicators of Malicious Activity
description: Objective 2.4's named indicators, matched to what each one usually means.
rows: Brute force or password spraying — one account is usually the user, many at once is spraying
Same account active in two places — credential compromise
Logins too geographically distant for the time elapsed — stolen credentials, unambiguously
A control stopped something — worth investigating what tried to run
Something is eating capacity — cryptominer (CPU), exfiltration (outbound bandwidth)
Access is being denied — ransomware encryption or a successful DoS
Activity at times that don't fit normal patterns — the timing itself is the anomaly
A gap where entries should be — treated as log tampering, not a glitch
The indicator matches a publicly reported campaign, advisory, or CVE
